name: TRS Information Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: TRS Information Technology Co., Ltd. provides artificial intelligence, big data, and data security products and services in China. The company provides TRS Hybase Search Database System, a search and analytics engine; Genevation, a professional domain database; Shu Jia, a SaaS platform that consolidates web-wide information from both public and private domains; TRS NetInsight big data analysis platform; and TianMu open-source intelligence service platform.
